# 4 bed house for sale

> We are delighted to bring to the market this spacious family 4 bed residence, ideally situated in the mature and well-established residential development of Racecourse Lawn, Tralee. The property offers generous and well-proportioned accommodation throughout, including a welcoming entrance hall, two reception rooms, a fitted kitchen and dining area, and an additional study / office on the ground…
